claim: 20% of treestock visitors click through to a nursery. Full-coverage performance referral clears $100/mo at today's traffic above ~1.2% conversion, and only Primal Fruits has a self-serve program.

body.measured: 2026-07-30 (DEC-241) from Plausible's Outbound Link: Click goal, which treestock_layout.py:36 has recorded since launch and nobody had queried in 126 days.
body.outbound_rate: 20% of all visitors click through to a nursery. A very high referral rate; the site works as a shopping utility.
body.affiliate_programs: All 27 nurseries probed (guessed paths + homepage fingerprints for GoAffPro, Refersion, UpPromote, Tapfiliate, ShareASale, Commission Factory, Impact, Awin, others). EXACTLY ONE has a self-serve program: Primal Fruits Perth (GoAffPro, branded 'Primal Club'), worth 33 clicks/mo (~$0.55/mo). Ladybird and Daleys, a third of all outbound clicks, have none. A first impact.com fingerprint on Ross Creek did not reproduce and is treated as a false positive.
body.monetisation_ceiling: CORRECTED 2026-07-30 (DEC-248). The figures published earlier the same day (~$21/mo conservative, ~$62/mo generous) were an arithmetic error, exactly 10.0x too small on both. On the SAME inputs: 1,245 x 3% x $70 x 8% = $209/mo, and 1,245 x 5% x $100 x 10% = $622/mo. A mid case (1% conversion, $85 order, 8% commission) is 6.8c per click = $85/mo, of which the top 3 nurseries alone are $36/mo and the top 10 are $66/mo. Full-coverage referral therefore CLEARS the $100/mo target at today's traffic on any conversion assumption above roughly 1.2%, and the top 3 nurseries alone cover the A$8.20/mo cash burn about 4x. The DEC-241 conclusion that referral 'does not reach $100/mo' was wrong.
body.conversion_rate_is_the_open_question: The per-click value swings 20x across plausible conversion rates (0.5% to 5%) and we have never measured it. Primal Fruits Perth is the only nursery with a self-serve program (GoAffPro) and it reports conversions automatically, so its 33 clicks/mo are worth far more as a measurement than as the ~$2/mo of commission. DEC-248: join that one first to price every other click on the site.
body.product_shape_matters: Benedict has declined PAID PLACEMENT twice (DAL-148 sponsored listings, DAL-79 featured listing page, /advertise.html suppressed 2026-06-15). He has never been asked about PERFORMANCE REFERRAL, which is a different product: commission on a completed sale, no ad units, no change to result ordering, disclosed. DEC-241 and DEC-245 lumped the two together. Standing ethics rule: ranking stays on list price and must never be influenced by commission.
body.status: DAL-245, assigned to Benedict. Reduced by DEC-248 to a single yes/no on performance referral (not ads), plus one self-serve signup.

measured_2026_08_13.note: Corrected 30d figures after fixing nursery_crm.py. Up from 1,245 clicks on 2026-07-30. The uncontacted share fell from 60% to 36%, which is outreach working, not traffic moving.
